"Build BUILD @COMMENT_BODY@ BATTLE, a polished, playable military strategy MMO inspired by Guns of Glory.

Create an original modern military base-building and warfare game with a professional dark navy, blue and metallic UI.

Core Gameplay

Players develop military bases, collect resources, construct buildings, research technologies, train armies, send military marches, gather resources and fight battles.

Resources

Cash, Food, Oil, Steel and Energy. Energy is not stored; it represents production versus consumption.

Buildings

HQ, Farm, Oil Pump, Iron Factory, Steel Mill, Concrete Factory, Power Plant, Warehouse, Training Center, Vehicle Factory, Artillery Factory, Hospital, Research Lab, Alliance Center and Intelligence Center.

Buildings must have levels, upgrade costs, construction timers, production and unlock requirements.

Army

Include Infantry, Vehicles, Ranged and Artillery units with five tiers. Each unit needs individual Attack, Defense, Health, Speed, Power, Upkeep, Load, training time and costs. Units must have distinct counter relationships.

Combat

Implement three deployment lines: Front, Middle and Back. Use deterministic combat calculations based on individual unit statistics.

Include a morale system. Morale decreases during battle, affects combat performance and causes retreat at zero. Troops committed to marches must remain part of the player's total army but become temporarily unavailable.

Generate detailed battle reports with casualties, wounded troops, damage, survivors and victory/defeat.

Other Systems

- Research technology tree.
- Military marches: Attack, Scout, Gather and Reinforce.
- Region system using lists and cards, NOT a conventional world map.
- Inventory with resource packages and speedups.
- Player profiles, alliances, chat, mail and notifications.

Technical Requirements

Use React, TypeScript and Vite for the frontend, C#/.NET for the backend and PostgreSQL for persistence when supported.

Keep gameplay server-authoritative and game balance data-driven. If backend support is unavailable, build a functional prototype with persistent local storage.

IMPORTANT

Actually BUILD the game. Do not just describe it.

Prioritize a working playable experience: base management, resource production, construction, army training, research, marches and combat.

Create polished screens, functional buttons, meaningful interactions and realistic progression. Test the game and fix errors before presenting the result.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- No backend was added; the work was proceeding as a local-storage prototype.

- Build “BUILD @COMMENT_BODY@ BATTLE,” a polished, playable military base-building and warfare strategy game using the existing React/TypeScript/Vite prototype.

## Requirements
- Implement base management, resource production, construction, army training, research, marches, combat, reports, and persistent progression.
- Include Cash, Food, Oil, Steel, and non-stored Energy; the 16 requested buildings; four unit classes with five tiers and individual stats; three combat lines and morale.
- Include deterministic combat, casualties and reports, Attack/Scout/Gather/Reinforce marches, region cards, inventory, profiles, alliances, chat, mail, and notifications.
- Use a polished, responsive dark navy/blue/metallic UI; test the game and fix errors.
- Use C#/.NET and PostgreSQL if supported; otherwise implement a functional local-storage prototype without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Proceed with local-storage persistence; no backend was added.
- The latest `src/App.tsx` write superseded earlier incomplete and larger drafts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created Vite/React/TypeScript project configuration and entry point.
- Added initial game data and model logic, including buildings, unit stats, research definitions, enemy targets, starter state, local-storage loading, march availability, power calculation, and game ticks.

### Active
- Continue the game implementation from the current `src/App.tsx`.

### Blocked
- The app cannot build until `src/App.tsx` has a completed UI and default export, and `src/styles.css` exists.

## Next Move

- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build “BUILD @COMMENT_BODY@ BATTLE,” a polished, playable military base-building and warfare strategy game using the existing React/TypeScript/Vite prototype.

## Requirements
- Implement base management, resource production, construction, army training, research, marches, combat, reports, and persistent progression.
- Include Cash, Food, Oil, Steel, and non-stored Energy; 16 buildings; four unit classes with five tiers and individual stats; three combat lines and morale.
- Include deterministic combat, casualties and reports, Attack/Scout/Gather/Reinforce marches, region cards, inventory, profiles, alliances, chat, mail, and notifications.
- Use a polished, responsive dark navy/blue/metallic UI; test the game and fix errors.
- Use C#/.NET and PostgreSQL if supported; otherwise implement a functional local-storage prototype without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Proceed with local-storage persistence; no backend was added.

## Work State
### Completed
- Set up Vite/React/TypeScript project files and app entry point.
- Added game data/model foundations and page components for base, army, research, region, inventory, alliance, and mail, plus dispatch and settings/production modal markup.
- Created initial dark navy UI styles.

### Active
- Validate `src/App.tsx` syntax and finish implementation.
- Complete responsive styling for remaining UI components.
- Build and test gameplay interactions, then fix issues.

### Blocked
- Build status is unknown; dependencies have not been installed and `npm run build` has not been run.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/App.tsx`, install dependencies, and run `npm run build`; resolve TypeScript/build errors.
2. Finish responsive CSS for region, inventory, alliance, mail, modal, toast, footer, and mobile navigation.
3. Exercise key gameplay interactions, confirm persistence and timers, and fix discovered defects.

## Relevant Files
- `src/App.tsx`: Game model logic, state, page components, and app UI.
- `src/styles.css`: Initial visual design; remaining page/modal/responsive styles need completion.
- `src/main.tsx`: React entry point importing `App` and stylesheet.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and React/TypeScript dependencies.
- `tsconfig.json`: TypeScript configuration.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.

## Objective
- Build “BUILD @COMMENT_BODY@ BATTLE,” a polished, playable military base-building and warfare strategy game using the existing React/TypeScript/Vite prototype.

## Requirements
- Implement base management, production, construction, army training, research, marches, combat, reports, and persistent progression.
- Include Cash, Food, Oil, Steel, non-stored Energy, 16 buildings, four unit classes, three combat lines, and military operations.
- Include Attack, Scout, Gather, and Reinforce marches; casualties and reports; region cards, inventory, profiles, alliances, chat, mail, and notifications.
- Use a polished, responsive dark navy/blue/metallic UI; test gameplay interactions and fix errors.
- Use C#/.NET and PostgreSQL if supported; otherwise implement a functional local-storage prototype without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Use local-storage persistence; no backend was added.

## Work State
### Completed
- Set up the Vite/React/TypeScript app, game model, page components, and dark responsive UI styling.
- Fixed TypeScript issues, added the default export and Vite CSS type reference, and completed responsive styles for region, inventory, alliance, modal, toast, footer, and mobile navigation.
- `npm run build` succeeds, producing the Vite production bundle.

### Active
- Validate and improve gameplay interactions, persistence, timers, and requested feature completeness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and exercise the gameplay flows, especially march deployment/completion, resource caps, construction/training/research timers, and local-save reload behavior.
2. Fix issues uncovered and verify `npm run build` again.

## Relevant Files
- `src/App.tsx`: Game model, persistence, gameplay logic, pages, and UI.
- `src/styles.css`: Visual design and responsive styling.
- `src/main.tsx`: React app entry point and stylesheet import.
- `package.json`: Dependencies and build scripts.
- `tsconfig.json`: TypeScript configuration.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- The previous `npm run build` passed with TypeScript and Vite; no gameplay interaction testing has been recorded.
- `src/App.tsx` uses very long, dense lines; inspect targeted sections when making changes.

## Objective
- Build “BUILD @COMMENT_BODY@ BATTLE,” a polished, playable military base-building and warfare strategy game using the existing React/TypeScript/Vite prototype.

## Requirements
- Implement base management, production, construction, army training, research, marches, combat, reports, and persistent progression.
- Include Cash, Food, Oil, Steel, non-stored Energy, 16 buildings, four unit classes, three combat lines, and Attack, Scout, Gather, and Reinforce operations.
- Include casualties and reports; region cards, inventory, profiles, alliances, chat, mail, and notifications.
- Use a polished, responsive dark navy/blue/metallic UI; test gameplay interactions and fix errors.
- Use C#/.NET and PostgreSQL if supported; otherwise implement a functional local-storage prototype without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Use local-storage persistence; no backend was added.

## Work State
### Completed
- Set up the Vite/React/TypeScript app, game model, page components, and responsive dark UI.
- Added wounded troop tracking and Field Hospital recovery, with Combat Medicine and Reactive Armor bonuses applied to gameplay.
- Applied research bonuses for attack power and march speed, fixed dispatch when no units are available, and capped supply-crate rewards at resource storage capacity.
- `npm run build` passed after these gameplay changes, before the final dispatch adjustment.

### Active
- Validate gameplay interactions, timers, persistence, and feature completeness; verify the latest change with a production build.

- (none)

1. Run `npm run build` after the latest dispatch adjustment.
2. Exercise march deployment/completion, resource caps, construction/training/research timers, wounded recovery, and local-save reload behavior; fix any issues found.

- `src/App.tsx`: Game model, persistence, gameplay logic, pages, and UI.
- `src/styles.css`: Visual design and responsive styling.
- `src/main.tsx`: React app entry point and stylesheet import.
- `package.json`: Dependencies and build scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- Most recent successful build completed before the final change to `dispatch` in `src/App.tsx`.
- `src/App.tsx` contains very long, dense lines; use targeted inspection when editing.
